title: Upgrade and Component Substitution Prices, Vacation Package Products
content:
Upgrading a component of a booked package, and substituting one component of the itinerary for another, are priced from this tariff. Each of the Vacation Package Products publishes whether components of the package may be upgraded after booking at all, the charge per night for a room upgrade within the package, the charge for a cabin grade upgrade for the whole sailing, the charge per traveller for a cabin upgrade on the package flight, and the charge to substitute one component of the package for another.

| Product | Upgrades after booking | Room upgrade per night | Cabin grade upgrade, whole sailing | Flight upgrade per traveller | Component substitution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | not permitted | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 299.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | permitted | 40.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 279.00 USD | 50.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | permitted | 55.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 349.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | permitted | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 399.00 USD | 95.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | permitted | 0.00 USD | 449.00 USD | 449.00 USD | 125.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | permitted | 95.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Reading the tariff

The room upgrade is priced per night and the cabin grade upgrade for the whole sailing, so the two are never the same measurement. The Ocean Cruise Package is the one product of the six publishing a cabin grade upgrade above nil, at 449.00 USD, and it is also the one publishing no room upgrade figure; the other five publish a room upgrade per night and no cabin grade figure.

The flight upgrade is a charge per traveller and rises from 279.00 USD on the Flex Bundle Package to 449.00 USD on the Ocean Cruise Package, standing at nil on the Luxury Collection Package. Component substitution likewise falls to nil on the Luxury Collection Package and stands highest at 125.00 USD on the Ocean Cruise Package.

The Value Bundle Package is the single product of the six on which upgrades after booking are not permitted; the figures published against it in the upgrade columns are the tariff the product carries, not a permission.
